ctx.main
.begin(y.view())
.fetch::<m![1], m![H % 120]>()
.fetch_cast::<f32>()
.collect::<m![H / 8 % 15], m![H % 8]>()
.vector_init()
.vector_intra_slice_tag(TagMode::Zero)
.vector_narrow_split::<m![H / 4 % 30], m![H % 4]>()
// `y^2 * s * s`: the stash is taken right after Narrow and consumed by the next op, the
// one position every shipped mean-square pass uses (the manual places the Fp stage's
// stash port at the stage, so a stash taken after `Mul0` may snapshot the stage input
// rather than `y * s`). Three multiplies on three ALUs commute, so the product is the
// same whatever order the Float cluster runs them in.
.vector_stash()
.vector_fp_binary(FpBinaryOp::MulF(FpMulAlu::Mul0), Stash)
.vector_fp_binary(FpBinaryOp::MulF(FpMulAlu::Mul1), scale_vrf)
.vector_fp_binary(FpBinaryOp::MulF(FpMulAlu::Fma), scale_vrf)
.vector_intra_slice_reduce::<H, m![1], m![1 # 4]>(IntraSliceReduceOpF32::Add)
.vector_fp_div(H_F32)
.vector_widen_pad::<m![1 # 8]>()
.vector_final()
.commit_trim::<m![1 # 8]>()
.commit_view(block.view_mut().tile::<m![Dummy8], 1, m![Dummy8 = 1 #{!} 8, 1 # 8]>(0))
